business_confirmed.description: True only if the other side explicitly confirmed it, in words

date.description: The agreed date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-24

confirmation_number.description: Exactly as the business said it, e.g. A1B2

staff_name.description: The name of the person at the business you spoke with, exactly as they said it, e.g. Marco. Never the business's own name. Leave it out if they gave no name.

open_items.description: Things the user must still act on or check. What changed on the call goes in result_items.

result_items.description: One row per thing the user asked for, or that the business added, saying what was actually agreed (asked vs. got). Include rows that match the brief too (status as_asked). Fill it when you report the outcome. Leave it out if the call ended before anything was discussed.

ref.title: ResultItemRef
ref.description: Which part of the brief this row is about. The system copies the user's own words from it for the Asked column, so do not write them yourself.

kind.title: ResultItemRefKind
kind.description: extra: something the business added that the brief never mentioned, such as a fee. extra has no key or index.

key.description: For task_var: the task variable name, e.g. party_size

index.description: For constraint, preference or fallback: its position in that list in the brief, starting at 0

label.description: One to three words naming the row, e.g. Cake, Pickup, Ice pack

got.description: What was agreed, in plain words, not what was first offered

status.title: ResultItemStatus
status.description: as_asked: it matches the brief. changed: a different result the user accepted or a fallback allowed. not_met: not agreed, and the user must act. extra: a new cost or condition.

reason.description: Why, in plain words. Leave it out for as_asked.

approved_by.title: ResultItemApproval
approved_by.description: brief: the brief or a fallback the user wrote allowed it. user: the user said yes during the call. none: nobody approved it. Leave it out if unsure.

cost_cents.description: For a fee or price: the amount in whole cents, e.g. 300 for $3. Leave it out otherwise.

business_said.description: The business's own words that support this row, copied as they said them. The system checks that they really said it. A row with no matching words is shown less prominently or left out.

follow_up.description: One sentence on what the user must do next, e.g. Call to confirm the cake is nut-free. Leave it out when nothing is needed.
